decisions.reason: The waterproof lined range is a flagship line built closely on the firm's core footwear and materials know-how, so in-house R&D can interpret results and keep refining it rather than abandon it.
ESD occupational shoes extend existing protective-footwear competence and serve steady industrial demand, though as a single model it is more exposed to range consolidation.

This safety shoe series sits squarely within the firm's established offer, so related knowledge lets it adapt the series through model updates instead of withdrawing it, despite normal collection turnover.
